result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers find the same cause (min-width:auto on .info combined with the nowrap name) and give essentially the same fix, including flex-shrink:0 on the fixed-size items and an optional two-line clamp for phones. A goes a little further on long content: it says to keep the full name readable with a title attribute, and it warns that an ancestor may have the same min-width problem. B's rules are slightly easier to paste as whole rules, but neither answer mentions the 28px tap target on the ⋯ button. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers find the same cause (min-width:auto on the flex:1 .info combined with nowrap) and give essentially the same fix. B goes further: it suggests a title attribute so truncated names stay readable, and warns that an ancestor flex or grid item may need min-width:0 too. Neither answer mentions that the 28px ⋯ button is too small to tap comfortably on a phone.
